title: tx_queue_count uses const qualifier but casts it away to lock
description:
Signature uses 'const struct tx_queue*' but implementation casts to non-const (line 383 in .c) to acquire mutex. Technically UB if original object was const-qualified. Inconsistent with tx_queue_empty and tx_queue_stats_get which correctly use non-const.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/tx_queue.h
Line: 192
